questions.scenario: Your school asks you to help build a new garden. Which task do you immediately choose?

options.text: Getting my hands dirty to test the soil quality and planting the seeds.
Setting up a smart, automated sprinkler system that waters plants on a timer.
Calculating how much water we are saving and ensuring zero plastic is used.
Drawing the master plan so the tall plants provide shade for the smaller ones.

questions.scenario: You are assigned a science project about the environment. What is your approach?

options.text: Doing a live biology experiment on how earthworms improve plant growth.
Building a mini-robot or using sensors to measure moisture in the dirt.
Writing a detailed report on how local pollution is affecting the ecosystem.
Creating a beautiful 3D model of a city that grows its own food completely.

questions.scenario: What is your favorite type of video game or hobby to play?

options.text: Games like Stardew Valley or Animal Crossing where I nurture nature.
Flying real drones or playing highly technical simulation games.
Strategy games where I have to manage resources and balance a budget.
Minecraft or Cities: Skylines, where I can build massive, intricate systems from scratch.

questions.scenario: You are organizing a camping trip with your friends. What is your main priority?

options.text: Foraging for wild berries and making sure we interact safely with wildlife.
Bringing the best solar-powered gadgets, GPS tools, and flashlights.
Making strict rules that nobody leaves even a single piece of trash behind.
Designing the perfect campsite layout so the fire, tents, and food are safely spaced.

questions.scenario: You find a broken electronic gadget at home. What is your first instinct?

options.text: Wonder if any organic materials or bioplastics were used to make it.
Open it up immediately to look at the circuits, sensors, and wiring.
Look up the proper, eco-friendly way to recycle e-waste in your city.
Take it apart and use the cool-looking pieces to build something completely new.

questions.scenario: How do you prefer to solve a complicated problem?

options.text: Observe it patiently for a while to understand its natural behavior before acting.
Look at the hard data, use a tool, and try to automate the solution.
Create a checklist or a new rule so the problem is permanently banned.
Redesign the whole situation so the problem actually becomes a useful advantage.

questions.scenario: When buying food at a supermarket, what catches your attention the most?

options.text: Checking if the label says '100% Organic' and 'Pesticide-Free'.
Scanning the QR code to track exactly which farm the food came from.
Checking if the packaging is biodegradable and environmentally friendly.
Looking at exotic veggies and imagining how to build a setup to grow them at home.

questions.scenario: What is the worst feeling for you?

options.text: Seeing plants die or animals suffering due to pollution.
When the Wi-Fi drops or a piece of technology keeps glitching.
Seeing people blatantly ignore rules that protect the environment.
Being forced to work in a messy, poorly designed space that makes no logical sense.

questions.scenario: If you could instantly download a new skill into your brain, what would it be?

options.text: The ability to instantly know the medicinal use of any plant on Earth.
The ability to code and build advanced robots from scratch.
The ability to perfectly calculate the carbon footprint of any business.
The ability to visually design zero-waste, eco-friendly houses in seconds.

questions.scenario: What kind of YouTube video are you most likely to watch at night?

options.text: A relaxing time-lapse of a seed sprouting and growing into a massive tree.
A tech review of the newest AI-powered tractor or drone.
A serious documentary on global warming and how we can stop it.
A tour of a beautiful, off-the-grid home that generates its own water and power.

Organic_Farming_Specialist.title: Organic Farming Specialist / Agronomist
Organic_Farming_Specialist.primary_match_text: You are a true nature-lover with a hands-on approach. You care deeply about the biology of the earth and want to grow things the natural way, without harmful chemicals.
Organic_Farming_Specialist.day_in_the_life: Testing soil health, finding natural ways to fight pests using good insects, and managing large fields to grow highly nutritious, chemical-free crops.
Organic_Farming_Specialist.alternative_match_text: Because you love biology and the outdoors, working directly with plants and natural ecosystems is a much better fit for you than sitting in a traditional lab.
Organic_Farming_Specialist.roadmap: Take Science (PCB) in 11th/12th. Pursue a B.Sc in Agriculture or Botany, followed by specialized courses in Organic Farming and Agronomy.

Precision_Ag_Technician.title: Precision Agriculture Technician
Precision_Ag_Technician.primary_match_text: You are highly tech-savvy and driven by efficiency. You love gadgets, data, and using modern technology to solve old-school problems.
Precision_Ag_Technician.day_in_the_life: Flying specialized drones to map crop health, writing code for automated irrigation systems, and analyzing data from soil sensors to maximize farm output.
Precision_Ag_Technician.alternative_match_text: If you love technology, robotics, and coding but want to apply it outdoors rather than in a cubicle, precision agriculture is the perfect frontier for you.
Precision_Ag_Technician.roadmap: Take Science (PCM) in 11th/12th. Pursue a B.Tech in Agricultural Engineering, Computer Science, or Electronics, and get certified in Drone Piloting or IoT (Internet of Things).

Sustainability_Consultant.title: Agricultural Sustainability Consultant
Sustainability_Consultant.primary_match_text: You are analytical, impact-driven, and a rule-follower. You want to fight climate change on a massive scale by ensuring people do things the right way.
Sustainability_Consultant.day_in_the_life: Visiting large agricultural companies to audit their carbon footprint, calculating their water waste, and creating strict green policies for them to follow.
Sustainability_Consultant.alternative_match_text: With your analytical mind and desire for global impact, creating policies and advising businesses on eco-friendly practices is an amazing way to make a difference.
Sustainability_Consultant.roadmap: Any stream works in 11th/12th (Science or Commerce preferred). Pursue a B.Sc or BBA in Environmental Science, followed by a Master's in Sustainability Management.

Permaculture_Designer.title: Permaculture Designer / Eco-Architect
Permaculture_Designer.primary_match_text: You are a creative systems-thinker. You have a designer's brain and love creating spaces where everything works together flawlessly like a natural puzzle.
Permaculture_Designer.day_in_the_life: Designing farm and garden layouts that mimic wild forests, planning rainwater harvesting systems, and creating stunning, self-sustaining eco-villages.
Permaculture_Designer.alternative_match_text: If you have an architect's mind but prefer working with nature, designing regenerative landscapes is a highly creative and fulfilling path.
Permaculture_Designer.roadmap: Take Science or Arts (with Geography/Design) in 11th/12th. Pursue a degree in Landscape Architecture or Environmental Design, and obtain a Permaculture Design Certificate (PDC).
